lastCompletedStory.title: Add allowlist .dockerignore for the cam-worker image build context

nextStoryContext: This PRD had exactly one story (US-001), now complete and passes:true. All non-operator stories are done; the review cycle should proceed. Real `docker build -f .devcontainer/Dockerfile .` was run locally (docker/orbstack available) and succeeded (exit 0); the '[internal] load build context: transferring context: 87B' line is the cited evidence for AC4. Note for the reviewer: on this machine's BuildKit driver (docker buildx via orbstack), the context-transfer size was already tiny (87B) even without the .dockerignore present, because modern BuildKit lazily syncs only the files referenced by COPY instructions. This does not invalidate the story: the .dockerignore is still correct and load-bearing (last-match-wins allowlist, matches the exact 4-line order required by the AC oracle) for the legacy builder and any BuildKit driver/CI runner without lazy FSSync, and it documents the COPY-needs-a-re-include contract for future Dockerfile changes. See the new patterns.md bullet for the full gotcha writeup.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docker docs confirm '!' negation re-includes a path and that the LAST matching line in .dockerignore wins, matching the implemented 4-line allowlist order ('*', '!.devcontainer', '.devcontainer/*', '!.devcontainer/claude-config.json'). Verified live with a real docker build (exit 0, COPY resolved).
